punchline: Sperry's split-brain research was real, but the idea of left-brained and right-brained people is an oversimplification.
thirty_sec: Roger Sperry won a 1981 Nobel Prize for split-brain research showing each hemisphere has some specialties. Tony Buzan built on it, linking words and logic to the left side and images and color to the right, and designed Mind Maps to use both. Modern neuroscience says the hemispheres work together and people aren't left- or right-brained. But the practical advice to combine words and images still helps.
question: Have you ever called yourself left-brained or right-brained?
